hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Protocol vaults. In beforeSwap, it fully handles swap execution: takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — bypassing standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate always revert to protect users from non-productive positions.
